title: CLI subcommands, exec plugin system, Rust plugin example, README
description:
Implement src/cli.rs and src/exec_plugin.rs, plus examples/custom_filter.rs, plugins/ example(s), README.md. Own ONLY these. Keep pub signatures (others code against them).
exec_plugin (external process plugins in any language):
- Manifest `<name>.toml` in plugin dirs: $SP_PLUGIN_PATH (colon-separated), ./plugins, ~/.config/sp/plugins. Fields: id, name, category (default "Plugin"), description, command (array, relative paths resolved against manifest dir, run with cwd = manifest dir), [[params]] key,label,min,max,default,step,unit,scale("linear"/"log"),choices. Use serde+toml. Invalid manifests -> reg.warnings.
- Protocol: stdin/stdout raw interleaved f32le; env SP_SAMPLE_RATE, SP_CHANNELS, SP_PARAM_<KEY uppercased>=value for each param. Plugin must write exactly as many samples as it reads, flushing after each chunk.
- ExecFilter implements Filter: spawns process lazily; a writer thread (mpsc of Vec<f32>) and a reader thread (bytes->f32, handle partial reads) so process() never blocks on pipes. realtime: wait up to ~20ms for enough output, otherwise leave dry signal (log stall once); offline (realtime false): block up to 5s. set_param: mark dirty and restart process (debounce ~150ms) since params are env vars. Kill child on Drop. Child stderr -> log file in std::env::temp_dir() (sp-plugin-<id>.log) so it doesn't corrupt the TUI. Process death -> passthrough.
- ExecSpec: extend as needed (name, params...), build_command sets env vars.
- plugins/bitcrush.toml + plugins/bitcrush.py (python3 stdlib only, uses struct/array; params bits 1..16 step 1 def 8, downsample 1..32 step 1 def 4). Maybe also plugins/tremolo... no, tremolo goes to the Rust example.
cli.rs (hand-rolled arg parsing, no clap):
  sp <file> [--device NAME] -> tui::run
  sp list   -> filters with id, name, category, params (key range default unit)
  sp devices -> output devices
  sp decode <file> [--rate R] [--channels C] -> raw f32le stdout (audio::decode_file + convert)
  sp filter <id> [key=value ...] [--rate R] [--channels C] -> stdin->stdout through desc.instantiate (realtime false), blocks of 1024 frames; for Exec plugins exec spec.build_command() with inherited stdio instead.
  sp play [--rate R] [--channels C] [--device NAME] -> stdin -> audio::open_output; wait until ring drained at EOF.
  sp help / --help.
  Handle BrokenPipe gracefully (exit 0). export_pipeline as documented in the stub (shell-quote file path; use param keys; exec plugin nodes as `sp filter <id> ...` too).
- examples/custom_filter.rs: a Rust plugin "tremolo" (rate, depth, shape choices sine/square) registered on Registry::with_builtins() then soundpipe::run(reg). Document in README how to write Rust plugins and exec plugins.
- README.md: what it is, install (cargo install --path .), TUI usage + keys, CLI pipe examples, plugin authoring guide (both kinds), raw format.
Tests: unit tests for manifest parsing, export_pipeline output, arg parsing; an integration test in tests/ that runs bitcrush via ExecFilter (skip if python3 missing). Run `cargo test`, `cargo clippy`. Audio decode/output are being implemented concurrently by another agent in src/audio — code against the signatures. Other agents edit other files concurrently: if build fails in a file you don't own, wait ~1 min and retry; never edit it.
close_reason: cli.rs (parse/list/devices/decode/filter/play/export_pipeline), exec_plugin.rs (manifests, ExecFilter), bitcrush plugin, tremolo example, tests, README

title: Audio I/O (decode, resample, cpal output, wav) + real-time engine
description:
Implement src/audio/mod.rs (you may split into src/audio/*.rs submodules) and replace the stub src/engine.rs. Own ONLY these files. Keep every pub signature in both files (other agents code against them); you may add pub items.
Crates: cpal 0.17, symphonia 0.6 (API differs from 0.5 — see ~/.cargo/registry/src/*/symphonia-0.6.1/examples/basic-interleaved.rs), ringbuf 0.5 (HeapRb, HeapProd/HeapCons, traits::*), hound 3.5.
audio:
- decode_file via symphonia (handle mono/stereo/multichannel, skip DecodeError packets).
- convert: linear resample + channel remap.
- write_wav: 32-bit float.
- list_output_devices, open_output: cpal; pick preferred rate if device supports it else default config; f32 output (convert if device format differs); callback pops ring buffer, silence on underrun, honors `flush` flag.
engine (src/engine.rs): EngineHandle keeps a UI mirror of the chain (as the stub does) AND a DSP thread. Design: ring buffer ~ 4096 frames between engine thread and cpal callback (low latency for live knob tweaking); engine thread loop: apply commands from an mpsc channel (Insert with an already-instantiated Box<dyn Filter>, Remove, Move, SetParam, SetBypass, Play/Pause, Seek (reset filters + set flush flag), SetLooping, NewOutput{producer, config} after device change), then while playing and ring has room: take a 256..512 frame block from the converted source, process through non-bypassed nodes, record peak after each node + node.meter(), push; else sleep ~2ms. Filters are instantiated on the UI thread via desc.instantiate(&FilterContext{sample_rate: out rate, channels: out channels, realtime: true}, &params) and sent over. On device change: open new stream (new ring), reconvert source if rate/channels changed, re-instantiate all nodes at new ctx, send to engine. Shared position (AtomicU64 frames) and Meters (Arc<Mutex<Meters>> with peak decay). At end of source: loop if looping else pause at end. render_to_wav: background thread, offline ctx realtime:false, fresh instances from mirror, progress/done/error. take_error returns errors e.g. failed instantiate / device error.
Tests: unit tests for convert (rate/channels) and wav roundtrip (write then decode_file). Also a manual check: generate a test wav with a small Rust test or python and make sure decode works. Run `cargo test`, `cargo clippy`. Other agents edit other files concurrently: if the build fails in a file you don't own, wait ~1 min and retry; never edit it.
close_reason: Implemented audio I/O (symphonia decode, convert, hound wav, cpal output) and threaded real-time engine with ring buffer, meters, device switch, offline render; 18 unit tests + ignored real-device smoke test pass, clippy clean

title: TUI: chain view, picker, editors, mouse, output picker, export
description:
Implement the TUI in src/tui/ (mod.rs + any submodules, e.g. app.rs, view.rs, editors.rs). Own ONLY src/tui/. Use ratatui 0.29 (+ ratatui::crossterm re-export, enable mouse capture). Code against src/engine.rs EngineHandle (currently a stub with fake transport — the real one lands in parallel, same API), src/plugin.rs (Registry, ParamSpec::to_norm/from_norm/format_value, EditorKind, EQ_BANDS), src/audio (decode_file, list_output_devices), src/cli.rs export_pipeline.
run(registry, path, device): decode file (show error nicely if fails), EngineHandle::start, restore terminal on exit/panic.
UI (see user's spec): `sp song.mp3` shows `[song.mp3] ──▶ [Speaker]`; clicking an arrow or pressing `a` adds a filter there via a popup picker grouped by category (built-in + plugins, show description). Layout:
- top: file name, ▶/⏸, position/duration progress bar (click to seek), loop indicator.
- middle: chain of boxes source ──▶ filter ──▶ ... ──▶ speaker(device name). Each box has a small level meter (Meters peaks, dB scaled) under it; bypassed nodes dimmed with "(bypass)". Selected node highlighted. Horizontal scroll when too wide.
- bottom: editor panel for the selected filter (always visible), help line with keys.
Keys chain-focus: ←→/h l select, a add (after selected), d/Del delete, b bypass, </> (or shift+←→) move node, enter/tab focus editor, space play/pause, [ ] seek ∓5s, l loop, o output picker (devices list + "Render to WAV file…" which calls render_to_wav(<stem>.sp.wav) and shows progress), x export popup showing export_pipeline() and copying it via pbcopy if available, q quit. Editor focus: ↑↓ param, ←→ adjust 1% (shift 10%? use , . for fine), r reset param, esc back. Sliders editor: label, bar, formatted value; meter bar for meter_label (e.g. compressor gain reduction). Equalizer editor: vertical bars for the 8 bands with freq labels; ←→ band, ↑↓ gain ±0.5dB; extra params as sliders below.
Mouse: click node selects (click selected node → focus editor), click arrow → picker for insert at that position, click speaker → output picker, click/drag on slider sets value, scroll wheel on editor adjusts selected param, click picker items.
Show registry.warnings and engine.take_error() in a status line. ~30fps redraw via event::poll timeout.
Keep rendering/layout logic testable: put hit-testing/layout in pure functions with unit tests (e.g. chain layout positions, arrow hit -> insert index). Test with ratatui TestBackend for a render snapshot sanity check. Run `cargo test`, `cargo clippy`. Other agents edit other files concurrently: if the build fails in a file you don't own, wait ~1 min and retry; never edit it.
close_reason: TUI implemented in src/tui/ (chain view, picker, sliders+EQ editors, mouse, output picker, WAV render, export); 19 unit/render tests pass, clippy clean

title: DSP: chorus, flanger, delay, echo, reverb
description:
Implement built-in filters in src/filters/{modulation,delay,reverb}.rs (+ an optional private helper file src/filters/delayline.rs which you may add to src/filters/mod.rs as `mod delayline;` — the only mod.rs edit allowed). Own ONLY these files.
Contract: src/plugin.rs (Filter trait, ParamSpec builder, FilterDescriptor::native). Interleaved f32 buffers, per-channel state, preallocate buffers in the factory (max delay times) — no allocation in process(). Scale buffer sizes with ctx.sample_rate.
- modulation.rs: chorus_descriptor (id "chorus": rate Hz 0.05..5 log def 0.8, depth ms 0..10 def 3, delay ms 5..30 def 15, mix 0..1 def 0.5) and flanger_descriptor (id "flanger": rate 0.05..5 log def 0.25, depth ms 0..5 def 2, delay ms 0.1..5 def 1, feedback -0.95..0.95 def 0.5, mix 0..1 def 0.5). Fractional delay with interpolation; LFO phase offset per channel for stereo width.
- delay.rs: delay_descriptor (id "delay": time ms 1..2000 log def 350, feedback 0..0.95 def 0.35, mix 0..1 def 0.35) and echo_descriptor (id "echo", tape-style: time ms 20..2000 log def 300, feedback 0..0.95 def 0.5, tone Hz 500..12000 log def 3000 = one-pole lowpass in feedback path, pingpong choices ["off","on"] def 1 (only when channels==2), mix def 0.4). Smooth time changes to avoid zipper clicks.
- reverb.rs: id "reverb": Freeverb (8 combs + 4 allpasses per channel, stereo spread 23 samples, tunings scaled by sample_rate/44100): size 0..1 def 0.6, damping 0..1 def 0.5, width 0..1 def 1, predelay ms 0..200 def 10, mix 0..1 def 0.3.
Each descriptor gets .description("one line").
Tests: unit tests per file (impulse response of delay appears at right sample; outputs finite and bounded for long noise input with feedback 0.95; reverb tail decays). Run `cargo test` and `cargo clippy`. Other agents edit other files concurrently: if build fails in a file you don't own, wait ~1 min and retry; never edit it.
close_reason: Implemented chorus, flanger, delay, echo (tape/pingpong), Freeverb reverb + delayline helper with tests; cargo test and clippy clean

title: DSP: biquad, low/high-pass, EQ, gain, compressor, distortion
description:
Implement built-in filters in src/filters/{biquad,pass,eq,gain,compressor,distortion}.rs. Own ONLY these files.
Contract: src/plugin.rs (Filter trait, ParamSpec builder, FilterDescriptor::native, EditorKind, EQ_BANDS). Interleaved f32 buffers, ctx.channels channels, per-channel state, no allocation in process().
- biquad.rs: RBJ cookbook biquad (lowpass, highpass, peaking, lowshelf, highshelf), TDF-II, per-channel state, recompute coeffs only on param change.
- pass.rs: lowpass_descriptor (id "lowpass": cutoff 20..20000 Hz log default 1000, q 0.1..10 default 0.707), highpass_descriptor (id "highpass", cutoff default 200).
- eq.rs: id "eq", name "Equalizer", .editor(EditorKind::Equalizer). FIRST 8 params are band gains in dB (-12..12, default 0) at EQ_BANDS order, keys "b60","b150","b400","b1k","b2k5","b6k","b12k","b16k"; band 0 lowshelf, band 7 highshelf, rest peaking Q~1.0; then "output" gain dB -12..12. Skip bands >= 0.45*sample_rate safely.
- gain.rs: id "gain", gain dB -60..24 default 0, pan -1..1 default 0 (stereo only).
- compressor.rs: id "compressor": threshold dB -60..0 (def -18), ratio 1..20 (def 4), attack ms 0.1..100 log (def 10), release ms 10..1000 log (def 120), knee dB 0..12 (def 6), makeup dB 0..24 (def 0). Linked stereo detection, .meter("Gain reduction") and meter() returns current gain reduction in dB (positive number).
- distortion.rs: id "distortion": drive dB 0..40 (def 12), mode choices ["soft","hard","fuzz"], tone Hz 500..20000 log (post lowpass, def 8000), mix 0..1 (def 1), output dB -24..6 (def -6).
Each descriptor gets .description("one line").
Tests: unit tests in each file (e.g. lowpass attenuates 10k sine at cutoff 500, EQ +12 at 1k boosts 1k sine, compressor reduces loud signal, all outputs finite). Run `cargo test` and `cargo clippy`. Other agents are editing other files concurrently: if the build fails in a file you don't own, wait ~1 min and retry; never edit it.
close_reason: Implemented biquad, lowpass/highpass, 8-band EQ, gain/pan, compressor (meter), distortion with unit tests; all passing, clippy clean

title: bitcrush.py prints BrokenPipeError traceback when downstream closes
description: sp decode x | sp filter bitcrush | head -c 100 prints a Python traceback. Expected quiet exit. Fixed in plugins/bitcrush.py (+ round-half-up).

title: Reverb wet level up to +23 dB at size=1 damping=0 (no feedback gain compensation)
description: sp filter reverb size=1 damping=0 mix=1 on full-scale noise peaks 13.2 (rms +12 dB). Expected roughly level-matched. Fix: wet scale compensated by sqrt(1-fb^2); test bound tightened.
close_reason: Reverb wet scale compensated by sqrt(1-fb^2); noise gain within ~+/-5 dB across params; test bound tightened to 4.0
